detail.body:
## Purpose

Make the existing determinism tests runnable for MLA models such as DeepSeek-V3.1 and Kimi-K2-Thinking by fixing two test setup problems:

- `test_decode_logprobs_match_prefill_logprobs` hardcodes `FLASH_ATTN`, which does not support MLA. Use `DEFAULT_BACKEND`, selecting `TRITON_MLA` when it is in `BACKENDS` and retaining `FLASH_ATTN` for the default model.
- `test_logprobs_bitwise_batch_invariance_ragged_chunked_prefill` loads the tokenizer without `trust_remote_code`, so Kimi-K2-Thinking's tokenizer cannot load. Pass `trust_remote_code=True`.

## Test Plan

Recorded pytest commands below; GPU tests were run with `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1`.

Before: Kimi-K2-Thinking on GB300, TP=4, `main` at `d09ff77637` plus the separate bugfix patches:

```text
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 VLLM_TEST_MODEL=moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Thinking VLLM_TP_SIZE=4 VLLM_TEST_TP_SIZE=4 VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.9 python -m pytest -p no:rerunfailures -p no:cacheprovider -v 'tests/v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py::test_logprobs_bitwise_batch_invariance_ragged_chunked_prefill[TRITON_MLA]'
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 VLLM_TEST_MODEL=moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Thinking VLLM_TP_SIZE=4 VLLM_TEST_TP_SIZE=4 VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.9 python -m pytest -p no:rerunfailures -p no:cacheprovider -v 'tests/v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py::test_decode_logprobs_match_prefill_logprobs[FLASH_ATTN]'
```

After: the same GB300 tree plus the change in `b0d5c22170`, TP=4, for Kimi-K2-Thinking and DeepSeek-V3.1:

```text
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 VLLM_TEST_MODEL=moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Thinking VLLM_TP_SIZE=4 VLLM_TEST_TP_SIZE=4 VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.9 python -m pytest -p no:rerunfailures -p no:cacheprovider -v 'tests/v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py::test_logprobs_bitwise_batch_invariance_ragged_chunked_prefill[TRITON_MLA]'
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 VLLM_TEST_MODEL=moonshotai/Kimi-K2-Thinking VLLM_TP_SIZE=4 VLLM_TEST_TP_SIZE=4 VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.9 python -m pytest -p no:rerunfailures -p no:cacheprovider -v 'tests/v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py::test_decode_logprobs_match_prefill_logprobs[TRITON_MLA]'
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 VLLM_TEST_MODEL=deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1 VLLM_TP_SIZE=4 VLLM_TEST_TP_SIZE=4 VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.9 python -m pytest -p no:rerunfailures -p no:cacheprovider -v 'tests/v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py::test_logprobs_bitwise_batch_invariance_ragged_chunked_prefill[TRITON_MLA]'
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 VLLM_TEST_MODEL=deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1 VLLM_TP_SIZE=4 VLLM_TEST_TP_SIZE=4 VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.9 python -m pytest -p no:rerunfailures -p no:cacheprovider -v 'tests/v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py::test_decode_logprobs_match_prefill_logprobs[TRITON_MLA]'
```

Default CI model regression: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B on one A10, `main` plus `b0d5c22170`:

```text
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3 VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 python -m pytest -v tests/v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py -k "test_decode_logprobs_match_prefill_logprobs or ragged_chunked_prefill"
```

## Test Result

The GB300 trees also carry the local patches from the separate bugfix PRs #61035/#61036/#61037/#61038, which do not touch these test files; the recorded `COMMIT:` lines retain the base commit and report the additional changed files, including this test change in the after runs.

detail.title: [Test] Make the determinism tests runnable for MLA models

files.patch:
@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@
 from transformers import AutoTokenizer
 from utils import (
     BACKENDS,
+    DEFAULT_BACKEND,
     TEST_MODEL,
     _extract_step_logprobs,
     _random_prompt,
@@ -395,7 +396,7 @@ def test_logprobs_bitwise_batch_invariance_ragged_chunked_prefill(backend):
     # depends on the tokenizer, so derive the budget rather than hardcode it:
     # half the longest prompt splits that prefill whatever TEST_MODEL is, while
     # the shorter prompts are still co-scheduled whole. Floor is max_num_seqs.
-    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(TEST_MODEL)
+    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(TEST_MODEL, trust_remote_code=True)
     prompt_lens = [len(tokenizer(p).input_ids) for p in prompts]
     max_num_batched_tokens = max(len(prompts), max(prompt_lens) // 2)
     assert max_num_batched_tokens < max(prompt_lens), (
@@ -714,7 +715,7 @@ def test_logprobs_without_batch_invariance_should_fail(
 
 
 @skip_if_not_cuda
-@pytest.mark.parametrize("backend", ["FLASH_ATTN"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("backend", [DEFAULT_BACKEND])
 def test_decode_logprobs_match_prefill_logprobs(
     backend,
 ):

@@ -58,6 +58,10 @@ class DeviceConfig(NamedTuple):
     {b for cfg in DEVICE_BACKENDS.values() if cfg.available for b in cfg.backends}
 )
 
+# Backend for tests that only need one backend. MLA models cannot be served
+# by the standard backends, so use TRITON_MLA for them.
+DEFAULT_BACKEND: str = "TRITON_MLA" if "TRITON_MLA" in BACKENDS else "FLASH_ATTN"
+
 skip_unsupported = pytest.mark.skipif(
     not any(cfg.available for cfg in DEVICE_BACKENDS.values()),
     reason="Requires CUDA >= Ampere (SM80) or Intel XPU with Triton",
